notes.title: We Just Launched!!!
notes.notes:
Hey Steam,

We at CodeWorks are excited to bring to Steam our first VR Game. 

Song Samurai is a rhythm game were we combined the ideas of fruit ninja with guitar hero. For legal reasons you will need to provide your own music after installing this game. Please open your game folder and drop your music files into the songs directory. 

Let us know if you have any questions or need any support on getting your songs into the game. 

Also please feel free to provide feedback or feature requests. We hope to work with the community to bring you the best VR rhythm game.

Thanks
